# The Hpo index was developed within the H2020 project SWAMI and is produced by
# Geomagnetic Observatory Niemegk, GFZ German Research Centre for Geosciences.
# This file distributes the hourly Hp60 and ap60 index, both are unitless.
#
#
#
#
# Short file description:
# 35 header lines, all starting with #, none longer than 80 characters.
# ASCII, blank separated and fixed length, missing data indicated by -1.000 for
# Hp60 and -1 for ap60.
# YYYY MM DD is date of UT day.
# hh.h is starting time in hours of interval for which Hp60 and ap60 are given.
# hh._m is mid time in hours of interval for which Hp60 and ap60 are given.
# days is days since 1932-01-01 00:00 UT to start of interval.
# days_m is days since 1932-01-01 00:00 UT to mid of interval.
# Hp60 hourly Hpo index (Kp-like, open-ended, unitless).
# ap60 hourly Hpo index (ap-like, linear, open-ended, unitless).
# Currently always D = 0, reserved for future use.
#
# The format for each line is (i stands for integer, f for float):
#iii ii ii ff.f ff.ff fffff.fffff fffff.fffff ff.fff iiii i
# The parameters in each line are:
#YYY MM DD hh.h hh._m        days      days_m   Hp60 ap60 D
